integrity: The theorem includes an explicit all-depth proof, an independently coded finite-depth checker, and an effective asymptotic error estimate; finite tests do not establish all-depth correctness.
scientific_limitations: Powers of two and the complete square set only; endpoint Fourier projection norms. Intermediate exponents and mixed moduli are not addressed. Original full text of Stangl (1996) was inaccessible; mathematical priority search is bounded. Independent validation is not performed.
title: Sharp Fourier-algebra norms of all dyadic square residues: a radical recurrence and two-phase asymptotics
